rules: The extraction run must use a fresh context and must not read either ground-truth answer key.
The extraction run must not read the checked-in IC Support profiles or bindings.
The extraction run may use the observed schema because it exposes structure and types but no expected values.
The run must report the exact source digests it consumed.
Missing evidence must remain explicit as null or unknown where the observed schema permits it; unsupported inference is a failure.
Plasma-internal profile IDs are not part of the blind extraction score.
Profile reuse is evaluated as shared/different behavior independently from factual field extraction.
Revision overrides are not scored until a locked errata/revision source is added.
